title: OnePVP
description: Functional and lightweight PVP plug for servers with Purpur/Paper technology... Maximum lightness, with immense functionality and more.
body:
OnePVP is a complete PvP plugin designed to deliver a competitive, organized, and highly customizable experience for Minecraft servers. Built with performance in mind, it combines multiple essential systems into a single lightweight solution, fully compatible with Paper and Purpur servers.

⚔️ Main Features
Complete PvP System
Advanced PvP mechanics and combat management.
PvP-focused protections and gameplay features.
Multiple configuration options to fit your server's playstyle.
Clan System
Create and manage clans with ease.
Invite players and build powerful teams.
Encourage competition and teamwork across your community.
Betting System
Challenge other players in wager-based duels.
Flexible settings for rules and bet amounts.
Adds an extra layer of excitement and competitiveness.
Advanced Admin Tools
Intuitive commands for operators and administrators.
Practical management features.
Quick access to the plugin's core systems and controls.
Highly Customizable
Customize messages, permissions, and gameplay mechanics.
Adapt every system to match your server's needs.
Suitable for both small communities and large networks.
Lightweight & Optimized
Designed for high performance.
Low resource usage.
Stable and reliable for long-term use.
✅ Compatibility
Paper
Purpur

OnePVP is the all-in-one solution for server owners looking for a powerful, practical, and optimized PvP plugin. Bring competitive gameplay, clan battles, and wager duels together without relying on multiple separate plugins.
